blind.description: A stylized cartoon foliage bush / small shrub composed of rounded, overlapping leaf-cluster clumps. The surfaces are continuous, soft, and hand-painted/stylized with dark green undertones and bright yellow-green highlights on the top-facing leaf star patterns. No floating shards, holes, or unattached pieces. Sits directly on the ground without an added pedestal or base.
blind.from_above: From straight above it appears as a rounded cluster of leafy rosettes/flower-like leaf tufts, bright lime-green on top fading to deep forest green around the perimeter, casting a soft shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.5 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 to 3 ft wide.
